title: Natural affine rectangle comparison of coefficient short complexes
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ and $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $U\subset X$ and $V\subset Y$ be affine opens. Let $S=(F_1\to F_2\to F_3)$ be a short complex of module sheaves on $X$ with all three terms quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent], and let $G$ be quasi-coherent on $Y$. Put $W=\mathrm{pr}_1^{-1}U\cap\mathrm{pr}_2^{-1}V$ in $X\times_kY$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. There is an isomorphism of short complexes between the scalar sections of $S$ on $U$ tensored over $k$ with the scalar sections of $G$ on $V$, and the scalar sections on $W$ of $\mathrm{pr}_1^*S\otimes\mathrm{pr}_2^*G$. Pullback means tensorPullback [def-pc-module-pullback] and scalar sections mean [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations]. In particular, both arrows commute with the three term comparisons. There is no exactness hypothesis on $S$.

source.place: Tag 0BED, lemma-kunneth, affine case and equation-kunneth-on-cech; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BED

proof.text: The delivered canonical rectangle map is natural in the left coefficient. For each of the three quasi-coherent terms of S, use its bijectivity to obtain an isomorphism of scalar section modules via ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective and asIso.

Use ShortComplex.isoMk with these three isomorphisms. The two commutativity equations are the symmetries of picardExternalRectangleSectionsMap_naturality for S.f and S.g. The zero-map instance needed to form the mapped short complex follows from the additive pullback adjunction and additive tensoring. The proof is complete and requires no exactness hypothesis.

theorem picardExternal_affine_rectangle_comparison
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (U : X.Opens) (V : Y.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    (S : ShortComplex X.Modules)
    [S.X₁.IsQuasicoherent] [S.X₂.IsQuasicoherent] [S.X₃.IsQuasicoherent]
    (G : Y.Modules) [G.IsQuasicoherent] :
    Nonempty
      (((S.map (picardScalarSectionsFunctor f U)).map
        (tensorRight ((picardScalarSectionsFunctor g V).obj G))) ≅
        (S.map ((tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g) ⋙
          tensorRight ((tensorPullback (pullback.snd f g)).obj G)) ⋙
          picardScalarSectionsFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
            (pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ⊓ pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V))))
